camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro CreateOmsMysqlDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --Type INTERNET --Username omsTestUser --Name 'oms-mysql' --Password YWJjZDEyM0Ah
description_en: You can call this operation to create a MySQL data source.
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro create-oms-mysql-data-source --name oms-mysql --type INTERNET --username omsTestUser --password YWJjZDEyM0Ah --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOmsMysqlDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The name of the data source. It must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
Invalid characters, such as slashes (/), are not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
数据源名称。 长度为 2~128 个英文或中文字符，可包含数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
不可包含 “/” 等非法字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the MySQL data source.   
Valid values: INTERNET, VPC, RDS, PolarDB, and DG
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL 类型。  
包括 INTERNET、VPC、RDS、PolarDB 和 DG
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC to which the data source belongs.
If Type is set to VPC, this parameter is required.
parameters.help_zh:
数据源所属 VPC ID。
如 Type 为 VPC，则该字段必填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ECS instance of the data source.
If Type is set to RDS, PolarDB, or DG, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
数据源云实例 ID。
如 Type 为 RDS、PolarDB、DG，则该字段必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database gateway instance.
If Type is set to DG, this parameter is required.
parameters.help_zh:
database gateway，数据库网关实例 ID。
如 Type 为 DG，则该字段必填
parameters.name: dg_database_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the data source.
If Type is set to INTERNET or VPC, this parameter is required.
parameters.help_zh:
数据源 IP 地址。
如 Type 为 INTERNET、VPC，则该字段必填
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The port number of the data source.
If Type is set to INTERNET or VPC, this parameter is required.
parameters.help_zh:
数据源端口。
如 Type 为 INTERNET、VPC，则该字段必填
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.
If you specify this parameter, subsequent migration or synchronization operations will take effect on this database only.
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。
如填写，后续迁移或同步操作，只会针对该数据库操作
parameters.name: schema

parameters.help_en: The username that is used to access the database.
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The password of the username that is used to access the database. It must be Base64 encoded.   
For example, for the password abcd123@!, the Base64-encoded value is YWJjZDEyM0Ah.
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接密码（需经过 Base64 编码后传入）。  
例如，密码 abcd123@! 经过 Base64 转换后的值为 YWJjZDEyM0Ah
parameters.name: password

parameters.example: OMS  测试 MySQL 数据源
parameters.help_en:
The description of the data source.   

It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The default value is null
parameters.help_zh:
The description of the data source.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The default value is null
parameters.name: description
